originalTitle: India's top 7 cities face retail space crunch in malls, new supply down 57 pc in Jan-Jun: Anarock
simplifiedContent:
Here is the news item explained in simple language: 
In India's top 7 cities, there is a shortage of retail space in malls. According to Anarock, a company that tracks real estate, the amount of new retail space available in malls has decreased by 57% in the first half of 2026 compared to the same time last year. This means that there is less new space for stores to open in malls. The amount of retail space that was actually rented out in malls also decreased by 24% compared to last year, with about 4.1 million square feet of space being leased. This matters because it can impact the businesses that operate in these malls and the overall retail industry.

originalTitle: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: US futures gain as pause in Iran hostilities lifts sentiment
simplifiedContent: The US stock market is expected to have a good day today because of some positive news about Iran. There was a pause in fighting with Iran, which made investors feel more hopeful and confident. As a result, the Dow Jones and Nasdaq, which are two important measures of the stock market, are likely to go up. This means that people who own stocks might see their investments increase in value. This is a significant development because it can impact the overall performance of the stock market and affect the investments of many people.

originalTitle: India 10-year bond yield logs biggest plunge in 2 months as oil rally falters
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in simple terms: the price of oil (Brent crude) has dropped significantly, falling 4% and then another 9% after the US and Iran stopped fighting. This drop in oil prices has caused the yield on India's 10-year bond to decrease sharply, which is its biggest drop in 2 months. The yield is now lower because investors are less worried about inflation, which can be driven up by high oil prices. This matters because bond yields can affect the overall direction of the stock market and economy. The current price of oil is around $89 per barrel, down from $102 last week.

originalTitle: Global Fuel Markets Are Out of Slack as Wars Push Prices Higher
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening: big factories called refineries that make gasoline, diesel, and jet fuel are working extremely hard to produce as much fuel as possible. Because of wars, the demand for fuel is high and prices are going up. As a result, these refineries don't have much extra capacity to handle any unexpected problems. This means that if something goes wrong, fuel prices could go even higher. This situation is important because it could affect the cost of fuel and other related products.

originalTitle: US stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq futures jump up to 1.7% as oil prices tumble on easing US-Iran tensions
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in the stock market: the S&P 500 and Nasdaq are expected to go up by as much as 1.7% today. This is because oil prices are going down, which is a good thing for the economy, and it's happening because there's less tension between the US and Iran. Investors are also waiting to see how tech companies did financially, which could affect the market. The Federal Reserve, a group that helps control the economy, is also meeting soon, which is important for investors to watch. Overall, these factors are making investors more optimistic, which is why the stock market is expected to go up.

originalTitle: Hindustan Zinc share: Jefferies, HSBC to Nuvama — brokerages see big upside. Should you buy?
simplifiedContent: Some big investment companies, like Jefferies and YES Securities, think Hindustan Zinc is a good stock to buy. They made this decision after the company had a strong quarter, meaning it made a lot of money between April and June. The analysts like Hindustan Zinc because the prices for the metals it sells, like zinc and silver, are high, and it doesn't cost the company a lot to produce them. They also think the company's future projects will help it grow even more. This is why they are telling people to buy Hindustan Zinc stock, expecting its value to increase.
